PS3 'Home' 12.05.2007 1 min read

PS3 Home Beta Movie

Andy CASA, UCL East

A movie of Sony's multi-user environment for the Playstation 3, known as 'Home' has been leaked onto YouTube:



Although the footage is of low quality it does provide an insight into how Home is shaping up.

Comparisons with Second Life will abound over the next few months in the main stream press and time will tell how close it is to the PC/Mac based multi-user world. At the moment it is unsurprising how well Home is shaping up considering the power of the PS3.

Joystiq notes to enjoy the movie while you can as its liable to be deleted from YouTube shortly..

See our other PS3 Home posts for more details.
